title: Policeman Shot Dead by Militants in Bakakhel, Bannu
detail: Unidentified militants opened fire on police official Anwarullah Khan in the Bakakhel area of Bannu district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. He sustained critical injuries and was martyred at the scene. The attackers fled and police launched a search operation to locate them.

sources.name: The Nation — Policeman martyred in Bannu
